title: Old Fashioned Smoke Hot Slovakian Sirloin Steak Tips Stew
description: A hearty one-pot stew featuring tender sirloin steak tips in a rich and smoky sauce, perfect for a cold winter evening. This lacto-vegetarian friendly dish is a twist on traditional Slovakian cuisine.
instructions: Heat a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat and add the smoked paprika, caraway seeds, salt, and black pepper.
Add the sirloin steak tips and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the steak tips from the pot and set aside.
Add the garlic and onion to the pot and cook until the onion is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the mushrooms to the pot and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown, about 5 minutes.
Add the vegetable broth to the pot and bring to a boil.
Return the steak tips to the pot and reduce the heat to low.
Simmer the stew, covered, for 1 1/2 hours, or until the steak is tender.
Stir in the sour cream and cook for an additional 10 minutes.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
